place_name: Mother Mountain, Porvenir Canyon (Hermit Peak area), NM

place_name: Crenellation Crag, Western Fringe (Keyhole Canyon, Eldorado Mtns), NV

place_name: Benthos Buttress, Wallowa Mountains, OR

summit_or_glacier: Wilderness granite near Murray Saddle, roadless

Granite near Murray Saddle / Silver Creek at 8,251 ft.

place_name: Middle Limpy, Limpy Rocks (North Umpqua), OR

From the FS 4713-120 pullout hike down the ridge, then a grueling scramble down to Middle Limpy.

place_name: Rooster Rock, Lower Menagerie (Menagerie Wilderness), OR

Getting There: Hike forever, look to your right.

place_name: Echo Lake - Comeposer Wall, Murdock Basin (Uintas), UT

place_name: Futility Wall, upper Stairs Gulch (Big Cottonwood Canyon), UT

Usually accessible only July to September; approach has 4th class at the waterfall section.

place_name: South Fork Campground, Eastern Bighorns (near Buffalo), WY

summit_or_glacier: No - roadside campground slabs

10 minutes up the hill from Buffalo, across from South Fork Lodge; park by the campground.

place_name: Spiderweb Wall, Lost Twin Lakes (Cloud Peak Wilderness), WY

place_name: Dem Bones Buttress (Matternaught Peak), Grand Teton NP, WY

An ice axe is probably necessary for the descent until late season.

place_name: Nez Perce, Grand Teton NP, WY

Hike up Garnet Canyon from Lupine Meadows, then ascend a couloir above the Platforms.

place_name: The Chocolate Factory (by Whiskey Mountain Pinnacle), Wind River Range, WY
approach_stated: 5.5 miles with 3,000 ft gain (Whiskey Mountain/Ross Lake Trail 5 mi, then bushwhack)
summit_or_glacier: No summit; roadless backcountry

evidence.fact: The approach is 5.5 miles and has 3,000 ft of vertical gain.
Take the Whiskey Mountain/Ross Lake Trail 5 miles to a meadow, then bushwhack.

place_name: Cirque of the Sun, Wind River Range (North Fork Popo Agie), WY

Small cirque just south of the Monolith Cirque, seen from the North Fork trail.

place_name: Teepe Pillar, Grand Teton NP, WY

place_name: Altar of Algoot (below Tahquitz Peak lookout), San Jacinto Mtns, CA

Described as a back country alpine mountainside cirque where rock can be loose.

place_name: Matthes Crest, Tuolumne Meadows (Yosemite NP), CA
approach_stated: 3 mi on trail + 3 mi cross-country, 1,700 ft gain from Cathedral Lakes trailhead
summit_or_glacier: Yes - knife-edge ridge traverse

Huge knife-edge fin traverse with the true feel of a backcountry alpine climb.

place_name: Mount Chamberlin (Crabtree Lakes), High Sierra, CA

summit_or_glacier: 13,173 ft peak; backcountry wall

evidence.fact: Shortest approach: Whitney Trail to Trail Crest, then cross-country into Crabtree basin, about 12 miles.

place_name: Tuttle Slab (Tuttle Creek, opposite Lone Pine Peak), High Sierra, CA

summit_or_glacier: 1,500 ft slab; no glacier

A 1,500-foot north-facing slab across from Lone Pine Peak's south face.

place_name: Main Wall, Storm Crag (Mammoth Lakes Basin), CA

place_name: North Arete, Crystal Crag (Mammoth Lakes Basin), CA

place_name: The Pyramid, Lee Vining Canyon (Tioga Road), CA
